content: Taqdīm al-ʿAql is a brief lettrist work discussing the views of four groups on the relation between intellect and soul: the peripatetics, the illuminationists, the Sufis and the muḥaqqiqīn, i.e. the lettrists; one manuscript notes that it was presented to one Dawlat-i Sayyidiyya-yi Imāmiyya-yi Rażaviyya. It is unpublished.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Taqdīm al-ʿAql ʿalā l-Nafs
